image_description: A historical-style lamellar or scale armor breastplate displayed on a stand. The armor consists of vertical rows of small, dark metal scales laced together with leather thongs, reinforced by horizontal leather bands with brass rivets. It features wide shoulder straps made of leather and fabric, connecting to the main body. The interior lining appears to be padded fabric. The background shows a workshop or storage environment with boxes and tables.
